title: Geek Bar Digiflavour Lush Disposable Vape Device – Lush Ice
description:
Description
Warranty
Juicy watermelon meets a crisp, icy finish for a smooth, invigorating vaping experience that’s as refreshing as it is flavourful!
Discover the Geek Bar Digiflavour Lush Disposable, where flavour meets superior performance! Born from Geek Bar’s collaboration with Digiflavour, this compact powerhouse delivers up to 20,000 puffs with its robust 18ml e-liquid capacity and dual mesh coil technology, ensuring every puff is smooth and intensely flavourful!
Take control of your vaping experience with the Geek Bar Digiflavour Lush Disposable’s adjustable airflow and two distinct modes—Regular Mode for a balanced session or Dynamic Mode for a harder hit, and bolder flavour. A simple switch on the underside lets you adjust settings effortlessly, while the vibrant mega screen comes alive with dynamic animations, displaying your chosen mode in style.
Designed for convenient everyday use, the Geek Bar Digiflavour Lush features on-screen e-liquid and battery indication, with a compact design that effortlessly fits into your daily routine. Its powerful 820 mAh rechargeable battery ensures lasting performance and quick recharges via USB Type-C, keeping you powered throughout your day. Available in eight irresistible flavours, the Geek Bar Digiflavour Lush Disposable delivers a versatile, flavour-packed vaping experience that’s perfect for on-the-go enjoyment—wherever life takes you!
Up to 20000 puffs.
Dynamic Mode For Enhanced Airflow, Vapour And Flavour.
Mega Screen with E-liquid and Battery Indication.
Dual Mesh Coil.
Direct draw firing mechanism.
Contains 20ml e-liquid.
Integrated rechargeable 820mAh battery.
Please recycle when empty at a proper recycling depot.
Warranty
30 DAYS. NO HASSLES. GUARANTEED. YES, YOU READ THAT RIGHT.
We doubt you’ll have any problems with your purchases; however, we understand mistakes and oversights can happen. Sometimes it’s a manufacturing defect, poor battery life, or you just don’t like what you’ve paid for. No problem. For a period of 30 days from your purchase you can exchange your device for a new one or receive a FULL in-store or online credit. Physical damages to products void all warranties, express or implied.
DEVICE & DISPOSABLE WARRANTY CONDITIONS
To have a valid warranty claim on a device or disposable vape device, you must keep the product packaging/outer sleeve which contains the proof of purchase and authentication stickers. We cannot warranty devices or disposable vape devices without their original packaging.
